answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, so a farm of a thousand jade-named sock puppets must tie up a thousand deposits. Pair that with peer grading where jurors who approve junk lose their own stake, so even a sonnet-pretty answer from a fake account earns nothing unless it explains a real mechanism. Cost per fake rises linearly while payout falls, leaving sybil farms in the umber gloom of unprofitability.
